request.subject: UNIT:CULT:GUARD

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: a pulp-magazine secret society of the 1920s, mock-sinister, silly and never scary. Their fixed colours: soft midnight indigo cloth shaded deeper violet-blue, never black; pale cream candle wax and parchment; small pieces of warm polished brass; and exactly one accent colour, a bright glowing spring green, only as small flames and glows: candle flames, lamp glass, an eye-in-a-spiral sign.
layers.negative: blood, gore, guts, dripping, horror, creepy realism, slime, skull, bone, black cloth, grey cloth, torn cloth, ragged hems, purple, violet, magenta, pink, red cloth, red robe, orange flames, yellow flames, blue flames, gold armour, chrome, steel armour, sword, gun, pentagram, cross, large glowing area

layers.text: Class: one chunky cute unit figure with a big head, short sturdy body and one oversized signature weapon or tool, thick single-colour black outline, standing ready pose, both feet visible; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.
layers.negative: pedestal, base, plinth, round base, disc, rim, ground plate, platform, stand, terrain slab, dirt slab, grass square, stone block under the subject, isometric block, ground tile, grass, soil, scenery, background, cast shadow on the ground, multiple units, crowd

layers.text: Subject: Idol Bearer, a chunky cute stout wide secret-society member with a huge round head, the widest and squarest of its kind: a short bright royal blue hood squashed flat on top, the face hidden in the hood's dark opening except two big round cream-white eyes, a wide bell-shaped bright royal blue robe with a neat round hem down to the ground, pale cream slippers; both short arms straight up holding one squat grinning pale grey stone idol head with two small bright green eyes over its own head, the idol as big as the head under it, like two heads stacked; one figure only; no weapon, no staff, no beard, no skull; simple shapes and very few details.

The hood and the robe are a bright saturated royal blue, clearly blue cloth and much lighter than the black outline, never grey, charcoal, navy or black. The hands are pale cream mittens; no skin shows anywhere. The figure with its idol is drawn large: about 48 pixels wide and 74 pixels tall.
layers.negative: staff, wand, dagger, knife, beard, skull face, skeleton, grey robe, charcoal robe, black robe, wizard hat brim, cape, wings, skin, bare hands, two people, shield
